title: Smoky Uruguayan Salad Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful vegan salad bowl inspired by the bold flavors of Uruguay, featuring smoky ingredients and a tangy salad.
instructions: Toss sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly charred.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add beans and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a large bowl, combine greens, roasted sweet potatoes, beans, and vegan cheese.
Drizzle with homemade salad dressing and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional salad dressing if desired.
